sentences.text: This court vide order dated 27.11.2024 also directed the court below to verify the aforesaid compromise, within a period of one month.
But the learned counsel for the applicants informed this court that because of certain reason, parties could not appear before this court below to verify the aforesaid compromise.
5. In view of the above, one month further time is granted to the parties to appear before the court below for verification of the aforesaid compromise.
In case, parties appear before the court below then court below will verify the same within a period of one month from the date of receiving copy of this order.
After verification of the compromise, court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.

6. It is further provided that for a period of one month or till the verification of compromise,
whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
7. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 of BNSS, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.
